destinations.description: The paths divide between frozen Iceika, the island realms, Arcana and dreaming Vethea. Prepare equipment for each journey and consult the crafting records before spending rare fragments.

destinations.title: Starlight
destinations.description: Find Starlight Portal Ruins and pass the Gatekeeper's trial. The Orb of Prophecy opens a realm of strange gardens, living crystals and ancient war machines.

destinations.title: Deep Void
destinations.description: Beyond the bedrock waits a hostile world. Carry light and supplies, then seek the means to make a Void Pendant for the return. Its guardians hold the road to stronger equipment.

destinations.title: The Pit
destinations.description: Beyond the bedrock waits a hostile world. Carry light and supplies, then seek the means to make a Void Pendant for the return. Its guardians hold the road to stronger equipment.

destinations.title: Aurorian
destinations.description: Frame a gateway with Aurorian Portal Frames and awaken it with a Silentwood Stick. The Runestone Dungeon, Darkstone Dungeon and Moon Temple guard a path through moonlit metallurgy.

destinations.title: Atlantis
destinations.description: Build an Atlantean Core portal frame and open it with water. Prepare breathing equipment before crossing; ruins and treasure lie beneath the sea.

destinations.title: Lostcity
destinations.description: Place a bed on two diamond blocks and surround it with six skulls, then sleep to cross into the ruined city. Build a matching return bed before making a permanent outpost.

destinations.title: Void
destinations.description: Remain near bedrock until the Void draws you in. Learn to resist its influence, then establish a proper gateway and work through its crystal and essence tiers.

destinations.title: Depth
destinations.description: Forge a Depths Key and follow its gateway into the ancient depths. Gather local stone and souls, equip yourself for the ruins and uncover the relics left behind.

destinations.title: Tropics
destinations.description: Prepare a Pina Colada and a beach chair. Drink while seated at sunset to reach the tropics. Establish a coastal camp before venturing into reefs and volcanic country.

destinations.title: The Beyond
destinations.description: Defeat the Ender Dragon and collect its blood. Smelt End Stone into Void Stone, build a portal frame and awaken it with the blood to enter the Beyond.

destinations.title: Created Worlds
destinations.description: Your power grid can sustain a world. Begin with a modest dimension, learn its running cost and build a reserve before shaping richer terrain.
